Mpox reporting data from the 2022 New York City (USA) outbreak

mpoxdat.Rd

Surveillance line list data provided by the New York City (NYC) Health Department to accompany a nowcasting performance evaluation (doi: 10.2196/56495). Patients with a confirmed or probable mpox diagnosis or illness onset from July 8 through September 30, 2022 were included. The original dataset was aggregated into counts by collection date and report date.

Usage

data(mpoxdat)

Format

A data frame.

Source

https://github.com/nychealth/mpox_nowcast_eval

Details

Each row represents case counts aggregated by collection date, report date, and race/ethnicity. The columns are as follows:

  • dx_date: specimen collection date of the first positive mpox laboratory result, formatted in ISO8601 as YYYY-MM-DD.

  • dx_report_date: date the report of first positive mpox laboratory result was received by the NYC Health Department, formatted in ISO8601 as YYYY-MM-DD.

  • n: case count of individuals within those dates and race/ethnicity group.

References

ROHRER, Rebecca, et al. Nowcasting to Monitor Real-Time Mpox Trends During the 2022 Outbreak in New York City: Evaluation Using Reportable Disease Data Stratified by Race or Ethnicity. Online Journal of Public Health Informatics, 2025, vol. 17, no 1, p. e56495.
